outcome: Rate of exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge
cohort: 73 postpartum women (33 Chinese-born immigrants residing in Spain and 40 native Spanish women)
finding: While initial analysis suggested lower exclusive breastfeeding rates at hospital discharge among Chinese-born immigrants in Spain compared to native Spanish women, this difference was not observed when work conditions and cultural factors were considered.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
